# Synthetic repair fixture — scenario_tick

_provenance: synthetic-test-fixture

Every file under this directory is hand-written synthetic test data for
the WP-09 repair lane. The DAX text, revenue figures, and category names
are invented for tests; they are not customer data and must never be
presented as observed answers. The Microsoft `$schema` URL in
`visual.json` is part of the realistic PBIR shape, not a live reference.
